sloka: प्रच्छादयन्तौ गगनं शरजालैर्महाबलौ।तमस्त्रैः सूर्यसङ्काशैर्नैव पस्पृशतुः शरैः ।। ६.८०.२४ ।।
transliteration: pracchādayantau gaganaṁ śarajālairmahābalau।tamastraiḥ sūryasaṅkāśairnaiva paspṛśatuḥ śaraiḥ ।। 6.80.24 ।।

translations.english: Though the mighty Rama and Lakshmana were covering the sky with their arrows resembling the sun they could not touch Indrajith.
